title: Sagrada Familia Fast-Track Guided Tour
description: A certified local guide walks you through the basilica for two hours, decoding Gaudí's symbolism and the engineering behind the columns.
imageAlt: Sunlight through stained glass and columns inside the Sagrada Familia
bestFor: First-time visitors who want the full story

title: Guided Tour with Tower Access
description: Everything in the standard guided tour, plus elevator access to the Passion or Nativity Tower for the view over Barcelona.
imageAlt: Sagrada Familia spires with apostle statues
bestFor: Visitors who also want the skyline view

title: Skip-the-Line Entry Ticket
description: Basilica and museum entry without a guide — explore at your own pace if you'd rather skip the live commentary.
imageAlt: Sagrada Familia basilica facade in Barcelona
bestFor: Independent visitors on a tight budget
